newsitem.title: UK: UK's Biocure to buy needle disposal firm.
newsitem.headline: UK's Biocure to buy needle disposal firm.

text.p: Biocure Holdings Plc said on Monday it had bought a private firm called Needle Incinerator Company Ltd (NIC).
It will issue 100.5 million new ordinary Biocure shares as payment for NIC, which based on Biocure's mi-market share price is valued at 27.7 million stg.
NIC specilises in the disposal of medical biohazardous waste.
The new shares will account for around 60 percent of the issued ordinary share capital of the enlarged group, which will be called Medisys Plc.
The group also plans to delist its ordinary shares from the official list and will seek to have the enlarged ordinary share capital admitted to the Alternative Investment Market (AIM).
